tools.name: batch
tools.description: Run multiple registered commands in one transactional request. Later ops can reference earlier results with "$<id-or-index>.<jsonPath>" (e.g. "$0.instanceId"; "$$" escapes a literal '$'). transactional=true (default) groups every op into one Undo step and reverts all applied ops if any op fails; commands that mutate outside the Undo system (asset/file/settings writes) are rejected unless transactional=false. on_error=abort|continue (continue forces transactional=false); dry_run validates without mutating; time_budget_ms (default 50000) bounds execution — when exceeded the remaining ops are skipped and a transactional batch rolls back (submit long batches with "job": true). Excludes build, switch_build_target, package_*, editor_play/stop/pause, recompile, eval, eval_file, run_script, menu, open_scene/create_scene, async commands (run_tests/list_tests), runtime-only commands, and nested batch.

id.description: Optional id for referencing this op's result from a later op ("$<id>.<field>"). Unique within the batch; must match ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$ (not purely numeric, no dots).

command.description: Name of the registered command to run.

params.description: Parameters for the command. String values may reference a prior op's result: "$<id-or-index>.<jsonPath>".

operations.description: Ordered operations to run; each is { id?, command, params }. Max 200.

transactional.description: Group all ops into one Undo step and revert every applied op if any op fails. Default true. Forced false when on_error=continue. Rejects commands whose mutations Undo cannot revert (asset/file/settings writes).

on_error.description: abort (default): stop at the first failing op. continue: run every op, collecting per-op errors (forces transactional=false).

dry_run.description: Validate command names, parameters, reference topology and excluded commands without mutating anything.

result_fields.description: Optional per-op result projection: map of op id-or-index -> array of result field paths to keep (context economy).

time_budget_ms.description: Cooperative time budget for the whole batch in milliseconds (default 50000, max 3600000). Checked before each op after the first; when exhausted the remaining ops are skipped and a transactional batch rolls back. Use "job": true for long batches.

tools.name: build
tools.description: Trigger an async Player build and report the full BuildReport. Returns immediately (queued); poll build_status until status is 'completed'. DetailedBuildReport is included by default unless 'options' is supplied. Use dry_run to validate without building.

target.description: BuildTarget name (e.g. StandaloneWindows64). Defaults to the active target. Must be installed.

outputPath.description: Output path (absolute, or relative to the project root). Defaults to the last/auto path.

profileName.description: Build Profile name to activate before building (Unity 6 only; ignored otherwise).

options.description: BuildOptions names. Omit to get just DetailedBuildReport; supplying any disables that default.

scenes.description: Scene asset paths to build (e.g. Assets/Scenes/Main.unity). Defaults to EditorBuildSettings.

confirm.description: Acknowledge and run the build; without it the call is refused. Use dry_run to validate only.

dry_run.description: Validate target/outputPath/scenes without building.

tools.name: build_status
tools.description: Status of the current/most recent build: idle | queued | building | completed, with the full BuildReport (files, packedAssets, buildSteps, errors, warnings) once completed. Retained until the next build.

tools.name: cancel_lighting_bake
tools.description: Cancel an in-progress lighting bake (Lightmapping.Cancel()).

tools.name: cancel_navmesh_bake
tools.description: Cancel an in-progress NavMesh bake (NavMeshBuilder.Cancel()).

tools.name: cancel_occlusion_bake
tools.description: Cancel an in-progress occlusion bake (StaticOcclusionCulling.Cancel()).

tools.name: cancel_tests
tools.description: Cancel running test execution

tools.name: capture_game_view
tools.description: Capture the game view as a PNG. source=screen (default) captures what the Game window shows, incl. Screen Space - Overlay UI; source=camera renders a single camera instead and misses overlay UI. Returns it inline as base64, unless save_path is set (path-only result; pass include_inline_image=true to get both).

camera.description: Optional camera name (source=camera only); defaults to Camera.main, else the first enabled camera.

save_path.description: Optional project-relative path to write the PNG (e.g. Screenshots/foo.png). When set, the result omits the inline base64 image unless include_inline_image=true.

include_inline_image.description: Also return the image inline as base64 when save_path is set (default false: path-only result). Only meaningful together with save_path.

max_resolution.description: Cap on the inline image's longest edge (e.g. 512). Only applies when an inline image is returned (no save_path, or save_path + include_inline_image=true); the save_path file keeps the requested resolution.

source.description: What to capture: 'screen' (default) captures the game view's own render target — what the Game window shows, incl. Screen Space - Overlay UI (HUDs) in Play Mode; 'camera' renders a single camera off-screen instead and never sees overlay canvases. Defaults to 'camera' when a camera name is given.

tools.name: capture_scene_view
tools.description: Render the active Scene View to a PNG. Returns it inline as base64, unless save_path is set (path-only result; pass include_inline_image=true to get both).

save_path.description: Optional project-relative path to write the PNG (e.g. Screenshots/foo.png). When set, the result omits the inline base64 image unless include_inline_image=true.

include_inline_image.description: Also return the image inline as base64 when save_path is set (default false: path-only result). Only meaningful together with save_path.

max_resolution.description: Cap on the inline image's longest edge (e.g. 512). Only applies when an inline image is returned (no save_path, or save_path + include_inline_image=true); the save_path file keeps the requested resolution.

tools.name: cleanup_codereload
tools.description: Remove old code reload DLL versions and clear registry

force_domain_reload.description: Force Unity domain reload after cleanup

tools.name: clear_baked_lighting
tools.description: Clear baked lightmap data for the open scene(s). Destructive: requires confirm=true.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually clear (destructive, not undoable via Unity's Undo).

include_disk_cache.description: If true, also clear the GI disk cache (Lightmapping.ClearDiskCache()).

dry_run.description: If true, report what would be cleared without clearing.

tools.name: clear_console
tools.description: Clear the captured log buffer and the Unity Editor console.

tools.name: clear_navmesh
tools.description: Clear the baked NavMesh for the open scene(s). Destructive: requires confirm=true.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually clear (destructive, not undoable via Unity's Undo).

dry_run.description: If true, report what would be cleared without clearing.

tools.name: clear_occlusion_culling
tools.description: Clear baked occlusion-culling data for the open scene(s). Destructive: requires confirm=true.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually clear (destructive, not undoable via Unity's Undo).

dry_run.description: If true, report what would be cleared without clearing.

tools.name: codereload_status
tools.description: Show current code reload registry status and statistics

tools.name: console
tools.description: Get captured Unity console output (Editor or Player; supports tail, level filtering, and follow via a cursor)

tail.description: Maximum number of most-recent entries to return

level.description: Minimum severity to include: log | warn | error

since.description: Cursor: only return entries newer than this seq. Use the 'cursor' from a previous response to follow.

tools.name: console_status
tools.description: Console ground truth and buffer counters without pulling entries: compile-failure flag, Editor console counts, and the buffer's retained counts and cursor.

tools.name: copy_asset
tools.description: Copy an asset to a new path under the authoring root. The copy gets a fresh GUID.

asset.description: Reference to the asset to copy (path / guid / globalId).

destination.description: Destination asset path relative to the authoring root, including extension. The Assets/ prefix is optional.

confirm.description: Required (true) only when overwriting an existing asset at the destination path.

dry_run.description: If true, validate inputs and report what would be copied without writing anything.

tools.name: create_animation_clip
tools.description: Create an empty .anim AnimationClip asset under the authoring root, with an optional frame rate and loop flag.

path.description: Asset path ending in .anim, relative to the authoring root. The Assets/ prefix is optional.

frameRate.description: Sampling frame rate of the clip (default 60).

loop.description: If true, set the clip's loop-time flag in its AnimationClipSettings (default false).

confirm.description: Required (true) only when overwriting an existing asset at the path.

dry_run.description: If true, validate inputs and report what would be created without writing anything.

tools.name: create_animator_controller
tools.description: Create an .controller AnimatorController asset (with a default Base Layer) under the authoring root.

path.description: Asset path ending in .controller, relative to the authoring root. The Assets/ prefix is optional.

confirm.description: Required (true) only when overwriting an existing asset at the path.

dry_run.description: If true, validate inputs and report what would be created without writing anything.

tools.name: create_asset
tools.description: Create a new ScriptableObject (or other UnityEngine.Object) asset of the given type at a path under the authoring root.

path.description: Asset path relative to the authoring root, including extension (e.g. Data/Config.asset or Materials/Wall.mat). The Assets/ prefix is optional.

type.description: Fully-qualified or short type name to instantiate (e.g. UnityEngine.Material, MyGame.GameConfig). Must derive from UnityEngine.Object and be creatable.

shader.description: Material-only (ignored otherwise): shader name to assign (e.g. Standard, "Universal Render Pipeline/Lit"). When omitted, defaults to "Universal Render Pipeline/Lit" if a Scriptable Render Pipeline is active, otherwise the built-in "Standard" shader (falling back to "Standard" if URP/Lit is unavailable).

confirm.description: Required (true) only when overwriting an existing asset at the path. Ignored when the path is empty.

dry_run.description: If true, validate inputs and report what would be created without writing anything.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a folder under the authoring root (creates intermediate folders).

path.description: Folder path relative to the authoring root (default Assets/); the Assets/ prefix is optional. e.g. Gameplay/Enemies or Assets/Gameplay/Enemies

tools.name: create_gameobject
tools.description: Create an empty GameObject or a built-in primitive (cube/sphere/capsule/cylinder/plane/quad) in the active scene.

name.description: Name for the new GameObject. Defaults to 'GameObject' (or the primitive name).

primitive.description: Optional primitive type: cube, sphere, capsule, cylinder, plane, quad. Omit for an empty GameObject.

parent.description: Optional parent handle (globalId/path/guid/instanceId/hierarchyPath). The new object becomes a child of it.

tools.name: create_gameobjects
tools.description: Batch-create N empty GameObjects or primitives in one call. Optional positions/rotations/scales are arrays of [x,y,z] (length must equal count). Returns the created identities.

name.description: Base name. With count>1 and no explicit names, objects are suffixed Name1..NameN.

primitive.description: Optional primitive type: cube, sphere, capsule, cylinder, plane, quad. Omit for empty GameObjects.

parent.description: Optional parent handle. Every created object becomes a child of it.

count.description: How many GameObjects to create. Default 1.

positions.description: Local positions, one [x,y,z] per object. Length must equal count when supplied.

rotations.description: Local Euler rotations (degrees), one [x,y,z] per object. Length must equal count when supplied.

scales.description: Local scales, one [x,y,z] per object. Length must equal count when supplied.

tools.name: create_prefab
tools.description: Save a GameObject as a prefab asset at a project path; the source becomes a connected instance.

source.description: Reference to the source GameObject to save as a prefab (globalId/path/guid/instanceId/hierarchyPath).

path.description: Prefab asset path relative to the authoring root (the Assets/ prefix is optional and the .prefab extension is added if missing). e.g. Prefabs/Enemy or Prefabs/Enemy.prefab

tools.name: create_prefab_variant
tools.description: Create a prefab variant asset that inherits from a base prefab.

base.description: Reference to the base prefab asset (path/guid/globalId).

path.description: Variant prefab asset path relative to the authoring root (.prefab added if missing).

tools.name: create_scene
tools.description: Create a new scene and save it to the given path under the authoring root.

path.description: Scene path relative to the authoring root (default Assets/); the Assets/ prefix and the .unity extension are optional. e.g. Scenes/Level1

additive.description: Open the new scene additively alongside currently open scenes instead of replacing them.

template.description: Initial contents: 'empty' (default) for a blank scene, or 'default' to seed a Main Camera + Directional Light matching Unity's built-in 3D template.

tools.name: create_script
tools.description: Create a new C# script (default base class MonoBehaviour) from a template under the authoring root. NOTE: the type does not exist until a recompile completes — to attach it, call recompile, poll recompile_status, then attach_script.

name.description: Class/file name without extension, e.g. PlayerController. Must be a valid C# identifier.

path.description: Folder (relative to the authoring root; the Assets/ prefix is optional) to write the .cs into. Defaults to the authoring root.

namespace.description: Optional namespace to wrap the class in. Omit for the global namespace.

base_class.description: Base class to derive from. Defaults to MonoBehaviour.

overwrite.description: Overwrite the file if it already exists. Defaults to false (an existing file is an error).

tools.name: create_timeline
tools.description: Create a .playable TimelineAsset under the authoring root (optional frame rate). Requires the com.unity.timeline package.

path.description: Asset path ending in .playable, relative to the authoring root. The Assets/ prefix is optional.

confirm.description: Required (true) only when overwriting an existing asset at the path.

dry_run.description: If true, validate inputs and report what would be created without writing anything.

tools.name: delete_asset
tools.description: Delete an asset from the project. Destructive: requires confirm=true.

asset.description: Reference to the asset to delete (path / guid / globalId).

confirm.description: Must be true to actually delete. Without it the command refuses (destructive guard).

dry_run.description: If true, report the asset that would be deleted without deleting it.

tools.name: delete_gameobject
tools.description: Delete a GameObject from the scene (reversible via Undo).

target.description: Handle of the GameObject to delete.

tools.name: editor_focus
tools.description: Bring the Unity Editor window to the foreground

tools.name: editor_pause
tools.description: Toggle pause state of Unity Editor play mode

tools.name: editor_play
tools.description: Enter Unity Editor play mode

tools.name: editor_status
tools.description: Get detailed Unity Editor status and state information

tools.name: editor_stop
tools.description: Exit Unity Editor play mode

tools.name: eval
tools.description: Evaluate C# code dynamically using Roslyn compiler

tools.name: eval_file
tools.description: Evaluate C# code read from a .cs file on disk

file.description: Path to a .cs file to evaluate

tools.name: find_assets
tools.description: Find assets by type and/or name and/or label, returning their path, GUID and type. At least one filter is required.

type.description: Type name to filter by (e.g. Material, GameObject, ScriptableObject, MyGame.GameConfig). Resolved to a System.Type and matched against each asset's actual main type.

name.description: Name substring to filter by (AssetDatabase name filter).

label.description: Asset label to filter by (AssetDatabase 'l:' filter).

search_in.description: Folder to scope the search to, relative to the authoring root (default: the authoring root).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 200).

tools.name: find_gameobjects
tools.description: Find GameObjects in loaded scenes by name, tag, component type, and/or hierarchy path (filters are combined). Returns structured identities.

type.description: Component type name to match (e.g. 'Rigidbody', 'UnityEngine.Camera').

tools.name: get_animation_clip
tools.description: Read an AnimationClip's metadata and all float curve bindings (optionally with keyframes).

clip.description: Reference to the AnimationClip to read (path / guid / globalId).

includeKeys.description: If true, include each binding's keyframes (default false).

tools.name: get_animator_controller
tools.description: Read an AnimatorController's full structure: parameters, layers, states (with motion / default), and transitions (with conditions).

controller.description: Reference to the AnimatorController to read (path / guid / globalId).

tools.name: get_audio_settings
tools.description: Read project Audio settings (volume, rolloff scale, doppler factor).

tools.name: get_authoring_root
tools.description: Get the base folder (under Assets/) that bare authoring paths resolve against.

tools.name: get_build_settings
tools.description: Read the current build configuration from EditorUserBuildSettings / EditorBuildSettings.

tools.name: get_component_properties
tools.description: Get a component's serialized properties as a JSON map. Address the component by handle, or by GameObject handle + type.

target.description: Handle of the component, OR of the GameObject when 'type' is given.

type.description: Component type name on the target GameObject (omit when 'target' is a component handle).

tools.name: get_graphics_settings
tools.description: Read GraphicsSettings (default render pipeline).

tools.name: get_import_settings
tools.description: Read an asset's import settings, structured by importer type (texture/model/audio), including the default-platform fields and (for textures/audio) one platform override block.

asset.description: Reference to the asset whose importer to read (path / guid / globalId).

platform.description: Platform whose override to read: Default | Standalone | iOS | Android | WebGL | tvOS. Defaults to Default.

tools.name: get_input_settings
tools.description: Read the legacy Input Manager axes (names and count).

tools.name: get_lighting_settings
tools.description: Read the active LightingSettings (lightmapper, bounces, resolution, directional mode, AO, etc.).

tools.name: get_material_properties
tools.description: Read a material's shader, render queue, enabled keywords, and all shader properties with their current values (Color as [r,g,b,a], Vector as [x,y,z,w], Texture as an object reference).

material.description: Reference to the .mat asset (or a loaded material) to read (path / guid / globalId / instanceId).

tools.name: get_navmesh_settings
tools.description: Read the default agent's legacy NavMesh bake settings (agentRadius/Height/Slope/Climb, minRegionArea, voxelSize).

tools.name: get_performance_stats
tools.description: Read render, memory, and frame-timing stats (structured, read-only).

tools.name: get_physics_settings
tools.description: Read Physics settings (gravity, solver iterations, bounce threshold).

tools.name: get_player_settings
tools.description: Read PlayerSettings (company/product/version, scripting backend, API level).

tools.name: get_quality_settings
tools.description: Read QualitySettings (current level, level names, vSync, anti-aliasing).

tools.name: get_runtime_pipeline_settings
tools.description: Read Pipeline Runtime settings (enableInBuilds, port, requestTimeoutMs, enableAuditLogging, autoStart, maxWorkItemsPerFrame). Reports the settings in effect, falling back to built-in defaults when none have been authored; never creates the settings file.

tools.name: get_scene_hierarchy
tools.description: Return the GameObject tree of an open scene (or the active scene). Each node carries instanceId + hierarchyPath usable by GameObject commands.

path.description: Path of the open scene to snapshot (authoring-root relative; Assets/ prefix and .unity optional). Omit for the active scene.

tools.name: get_selection
tools.description: Read the current Editor selection as structured object identities.

tools.name: get_serialized_fields
tools.description: Read serialized fields of a component/asset. Returns each top-level field's name, type and value (object references are returned as re-usable handles). Pass 'field' to read a single SerializedProperty path. Pass format='value' to return just the value(s) — a token-efficient read for scalars.

target.description: Reference to the component or asset to read (globalId/path/guid/instanceId/hierarchyPath). May be a GameObject when 'component' is given.

field.description: Optional single SerializedProperty path to read (e.g. 'speed' or 'items.Array.data[0]'). Omit to read all top-level fields.

component.description: Component type name on the target GameObject (e.g. 'Rigidbody'). Use when 'target' is a GameObject; omit when 'target' is already a component handle.

format.description: Output shape. Omit (default) for a full descriptor per field {name,path,propertyType,isArray,arrayLength,value}; 'value' returns just the value(s): the raw value for a single 'field', or a {name: value} map for all fields.

tools.name: get_shader_properties
tools.description: Introspect a shader's declared property list (name, description, type Color|Vector|Float|Range|TexEnv|Int, range, textureDimension, flags). Provide 'shader' (by name) OR 'material' (read the shader off that material).

shader.description: Shader name (e.g. "Universal Render Pipeline/Lit"). Provide this OR 'material'.

material.description: Reference to a material to read the shader from instead of naming it. Provide this OR 'shader'.

tools.name: get_tags_layers
tools.description: Read the project's tags and (named) layers.

tools.name: get_time_settings
tools.description: Read Time settings (fixedDeltaTime, maximumDeltaTime, timeScale).

tools.name: get_timeline
tools.description: Read a TimelineAsset's structure: frame rate, duration, and its tracks with their clips. Requires the com.unity.timeline package.

timeline.description: Reference to the TimelineAsset to read (path / guid / globalId).

tools.name: import_asset
tools.description: Import an external file (e.g. a texture, model, audio clip) into the project by copying it to a path under the authoring root, then importing it.

source.description: Absolute filesystem path to the external file to import.

path.description: Destination asset path relative to the authoring root, including extension. The Assets/ prefix is optional.

confirm.description: Required (true) only when overwriting an existing asset at the destination path.

dry_run.description: If true, validate inputs and report what would be imported without writing anything.

tools.name: instantiate_prefab
tools.description: Instantiate a prefab asset into a loaded scene and return the created instance.

prefab.description: Reference to the prefab asset to instantiate (path/guid/globalId).

scene_path.description: Optional path of a loaded scene to instantiate into; defaults to the active scene.

name.description: Optional name for the created instance; defaults to the prefab name.

tools.name: lighting_bake_status
tools.description: Get the status of the last lighting bake: idle | baking | completed.

tools.name: list_build_profiles
tools.description: List Build Profile assets in the project (Unity 6 only). Returns feature_unavailable on earlier versions.

tools.name: list_build_targets
tools.description: List the known BuildTarget values with their group and whether build support is installed.

tools.name: list_open_scenes
tools.description: List all currently open scenes with their load/active/dirty state.

tools.name: list_shaders
tools.description: Discover available shaders so an agent can pick a valid name for set_material_properties / create_asset. Returns [{ name, assetPath|null, isBuiltin, isSupported }].

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against the shader name (e.g. "URP", "Lit").

includeBuiltin.description: Include built-in/engine shaders (those with no project asset path). Default true.

limit.description: Maximum number of shaders to return (default 200).

tools.name: list_tests
tools.description: List all available tests (EditMode and/or PlayMode) without running them

mode.description: Test mode: all, editor, playmode (default: all)

tools.name: log
tools.description: Write a message to Unity console

tools.name: menu
tools.description: Execute an Editor menu item by path, or list available items when no path is given

path.description: Menu item path to execute, e.g. "Assets/Reimport All". Omit to list available menu items.

tools.name: move_asset
tools.description: Move (or rename via a new path) an asset to a new location under the authoring root. Preserves the asset's GUID.

asset.description: Reference to the asset to move (path / guid / globalId).

destination.description: Destination asset path relative to the authoring root, including extension. The Assets/ prefix is optional.

dry_run.description: If true, validate the move (via AssetDatabase.ValidateMoveAsset) without performing it.

tools.name: navmesh_bake_status
tools.description: Get the status of the last NavMesh bake: idle | baking | completed.

tools.name: occlusion_bake_status
tools.description: Get the status of the last occlusion bake: idle | baking | completed.

tools.name: open_scene
tools.description: Open an existing scene from the given path.

path.description: Scene path relative to the authoring root (default Assets/); the Assets/ prefix and the .unity extension are optional.

additive.description: Open additively alongside currently open scenes instead of replacing them.

tools.name: package_add
tools.description: Add a UPM package by name@version, git URL, or 'file:' local path. Async by default (returns in_progress; poll package_status); pass wait=true to block until added. A recompile/domain reload follows — poll recompile_status. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview.

identifier.description: Package to add: 'com.unity.foo@1.2.3', a git URL, or 'file:../Path'.

confirm.description: Apply the change. Without it the call is refused.

dry_run.description: Preview the change without applying it.

wait.description: Block until the operation completes and return the result (synchronous). Default: return immediately and poll package_status.

tools.name: package_list
tools.description: List packages by scope: installed (default) | available (registry) | all (both). Returns the full result synchronously — available/all block until the registry query completes.

scope.description: Which packages to list: installed (default) | available | all.

include_indirect.description: Include indirect (transitive) installed dependencies (applies to scope=installed/all).

offline.description: For available/all: query the local cache instead of the registry.

tools.name: package_remove
tools.description: Remove a UPM package by name. Async by default (returns in_progress; poll package_status); pass wait=true to block until removed. A recompile/domain reload follows — poll recompile_status. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview.

confirm.description: Apply the change. Without it the call is refused.

wait.description: Block until the operation completes and return the result (synchronous). Default: return immediately and poll package_status.

tools.name: package_resolve
tools.description: Resolve/refresh packages from the manifest (re-fetch and re-link). May trigger a recompile/domain reload — poll recompile_status. Its outcome is recorded for package_status.

tools.name: package_status
tools.description: Status of the last async package operation (add/remove/resolve): idle | in_progress | completed | failed, with the added package, manifest, and any error.

tools.name: remove_animation_curve
tools.description: Remove a float curve binding from an AnimationClip (SetEditorCurve(clip, binding, null)). Destructive: requires confirm=true.

clip.description: Reference to the AnimationClip to edit (path / guid / globalId).

path.description: GameObject path relative to the animated root the binding lives on. Empty string (default) targets the root.

type.description: Component type of the binding to remove, e.g. "Transform". Resolved via the component TypeResolver.

property.description: Curve property name to remove, e.g. "m_LocalPosition.x".

confirm.description: Must be true to actually remove the binding (destructive guard).

dry_run.description: If true, report the binding that would be removed without removing it.

tools.name: remove_component
tools.description: Remove a component from a GameObject. Provide either a component handle (target) or a GameObject handle (target) plus a type name.

target.description: Handle of the component to remove, OR of the GameObject when 'type' is given.

type.description: Component type name to remove from the target GameObject (omit when 'target' already points at a component).

tools.name: remove_scene_from_build
tools.description: Remove a scene from the Build Settings scene list (idempotent).

path.description: Scene path to remove (authoring-root relative; Assets/ prefix and .unity optional).

tools.name: rename_asset
tools.description: Rename an asset in place (keeps it in the same folder, keeps its GUID).

asset.description: Reference to the asset to rename (path / guid / globalId).

new_name.description: New file name WITHOUT a folder path. The extension is preserved if omitted.

dry_run.description: If true, validate the rename without performing it.

tools.name: rename_gameobject
tools.description: Rename a GameObject.

target.description: Handle of the GameObject.

tools.name: report_evals
tools.description: Aggregate local eval-usage telemetry into a ranked report: API fingerprint frequency, one-liner percentage, error rate, and command-coverage suggestions.

top.description: Maximum entries in each ranked list (API fingerprints, and uncovered patterns suggested as commands). Accepted range: 0 or greater; negative values fall back to the default (50).

tools.name: revert_prefab_overrides
tools.description: Revert a prefab instance's overrides so it matches its source prefab asset.

instance.description: Reference to a prefab instance GameObject in a scene (instanceId/hierarchyPath/globalId).

tools.name: run_script
tools.description: Compile a project C# file in memory (no domain reload) and execute a named static entry point. The builder-pattern path for bulk construction. Still arbitrary code execution — shares eval's capability gate.

file.description: Path to a .cs file to compile. Relative paths resolve against the PROJECT ROOT (the parent of Assets/), not the process working directory. May live OUTSIDE Assets/ (e.g. AgentScripts/) so writing it never triggers an asset import or domain reload.

entry.description: Entry point as Namespace.Type.Method (or Type.Method, or a bare Method name). Default: the single public static method if unambiguous, else a method named Main. Static methods only in v1. Ephemeral mode only (rejected with mode=hotpatch, which never invokes an entry point).

args.description: JSON array of arguments passed to the entry point, coerced to its parameter types: primitives, enum names, string[], and a string/object handle (ObjectRef) for UnityEngine.Object parameters. Ephemeral mode only (rejected with mode=hotpatch).

mode.description: ephemeral (default): compile to an in-memory assembly, run the entry, discard. hotpatch: apply [CodeReload] method replacements to already-loaded types (reload_file semantics).

references.description: Extra assembly name prefixes to reference beyond the auto-resolved set. In the Editor all loaded assemblies are already referenced, so this is effectively a no-op there. Ephemeral mode only; not applied by hotpatch (which delegates to reload_file's own compile).

defines.description: Extra scripting define symbols APPENDED to the project's active editor defines (UNITY_EDITOR etc. are already set) for the compilation's #if directives. Ephemeral mode only; not applied by hotpatch.

pdb.description: Emit a portable PDB mapped to the source file so breakpoints bind and exception stack traces map to file:line. Compiles unoptimized.

timeout_ms.description: Timeout in milliseconds. Bounds the main-thread dispatcher wait AND, for an async entry point, how long its Task is awaited (on expiry the task keeps running detached).

dry_run.description: Compile only: return diagnostics; the emitted assembly is NOT loaded into the domain and nothing executes. Ephemeral mode only (rejected with mode=hotpatch, which would apply live method replacements).

tools.name: run_tests
tools.description: Execute Unity tests with filtering options

mode.description: Test mode: all, editor, playmode (default: all)

filter.description: Test name filter pattern (case-insensitive partial match)

filter_type.description: Filter type: testName, assembly, category (default: testName)

async_tests.description: Run asynchronously - return immediately, poll /test-status for results

rename_child.description: Optional child name (relative path under the root, e.g. 'Body/Head') to rename.

new_name.description: New name for the child identified by rename_child.

set_active_child.description: Optional child name (relative path under the root) whose active state to set.

active.description: Active state to apply when set_active_child is provided.

width.description: Output width in pixels. 0 (default) uses the view camera's current width.

height.description: Output height in pixels. 0 (default) uses the view camera's current height.

tools.name: search

query.description: Unity Search query string, e.g. 't:Material', 'p: my asset', 'h: Main Camera'.

clip.description: Reference to the AnimationClip to edit (path / guid / globalId).

path.description: GameObject path relative to the animated root the property lives on. Empty string (default) targets the root.

type.description: Component type the property lives on, e.g. "Transform", "UnityEngine.Light". Resolved via the component TypeResolver.

keys.description: Keyframes: [{ time, value, inTangent?, outTangent?, weightedMode?: "None"|"In"|"Out"|"Both" }]. Omitted tangents default to 0 (flat); this is NOT Unity's Auto tangent mode.

tools.name: set_authoring_root

tools.name: set_autotick
tools.description: Keep the editor ticking while unfocused by forcing EditorApplication.SignalTick at a throttled rate

interval_ms.description: Minimum milliseconds between forced ticks. 0 = every update (max rate, pegs a CPU core). Default 16 (~60Hz).

persist.description: Persist this choice to SessionState so it survives a domain reload. Set false for a one-off/expensive setting (e.g. interval_ms=0) that should revert to the last persisted choice (or the default) after the next recompile instead of sticking for the rest of the session.

tools.description: Set mutable EditorUserBuildSettings fields. Does NOT manage scenes (use add_scene_to_build / remove_scene_from_build) or switch target (use switch_build_target). Use dry_run to preview.

developmentBuild.description: Build a Development Player (enables the debugger/profiler).

allowDebugging.description: Allow script debugging (only effective with developmentBuild=true).

connectWithProfiler.description: Auto-connect the Profiler (only effective with developmentBuild=true).

buildScriptsOnly.description: Build only the scripts (skip data) for faster iteration.

symlinkSources.description: Symlink runtime/plugin sources instead of copying (where supported).

il2CppCodeGeneration.description: IL2CPP code generation for the active target: OptimizeSpeed | OptimizeSize.

settings.description: Fields to change; omitted fields are left unchanged.

properties.description: Map of serialized property name to value. Vectors/colors are arrays; object refs are handle objects.

renderPipelineAsset.description: Reference (path / guid / globalId) to a RenderPipelineAsset to set as the default. Pass an empty reference ({}) to select the built-in pipeline; omit to leave unchanged.

settings.description: Fields to change; omitted fields are left unchanged.

confirm.description: Apply the change. Without it the call is refused.

asset.description: Reference to the asset whose importer to edit (path / guid / globalId).

settings.description: JSON object of importer property/field names to values, e.g. {"isReadable": true, "textureType": "NormalMap"}. For platform != Default on a texture/audio importer, keys map onto the platform-settings struct (e.g. maxTextureSize, format, compressionFormat, quality, and overridden).

platform.description: Target platform: Default | Standalone | iOS | Android | WebGL | tvOS. Defaults to Default (top-level importer properties). A real platform writes a per-platform override (textures/audio only).

tools.description: Set shader properties on a material (Float/Range/Int=number; Color=[r,g,b,a] or "#RRGGBBAA" hex; Vector=[x,y,z,w]; Texture=an object reference or null to clear), optionally reassign the shader, set the render queue, and toggle keywords. Unknown names / type mismatches are reported in unknown[].

material.description: Reference to the .mat asset (or a loaded material) to edit (path / guid / globalId / instanceId).

shader.description: Reassign the material's shader by name (e.g. "Standard", "Universal Render Pipeline/Lit", or a Shader Graph shader name). Applied before properties so new property names resolve against the new shader.

properties.description: JSON object of shader property name -> value. Names must include the leading underscore (e.g. _BaseColor). Float/Range/Int=number; Color=[r,g,b,a] or hex string; Vector=[x,y,z,w]; Texture=an object reference {guid/path} or null.

renderQueue.description: Explicit render queue, or -1 to inherit from the shader. Omit to leave unchanged.

tools.name: wait_cancel
tools.description: Cancel an async wait started with wait_for (async=true).

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Wait server-side until a member condition holds, then optionally act in the same frame. Sync waits hold the exec queue (every other command waits behind them, including one the condition may depend on) — keep them short and self-contained; set async=true and poll wait_status for anything else.

member.description: Dotted member path. With no target/findType it is a fully-qualified static path (e.g. "UnityEditor.EditorApplication.isPlaying"); with target/findType it walks instance members (e.g. "State" or "Health.CurrentHealth"). Read-only members only.

target.description: Object handle (instanceId / hierarchyPath / guid / path / globalId) to read instance members from. Omit for a static member path or to use findType.

findType.description: Fully-qualified UnityEngine.Object type name; the member walks from its first loaded instance. Alternative to target.

op.description: Comparison: equals (default) | notEquals | greaterThan | lessThan | contains (strings) | changed (met on first change from the initially observed value; needs no value). changed is for value-like members (primitives/enums/strings); content mutations inside a reference-typed member are not detected.

value.description: Comparison operand, coerced to the member's type (primitive, enum name, or string). Required for every op except 'changed'. equals/notEquals accept an EXPLICIT null (e.g. wait-until-destroyed: a destroyed leaf value observes as null); omitting the key entirely is rejected.

condition.description: Condition to wait for: { member, target?, findType?, op, value }. member is a dotted path (static, or instance under target/findType); op is equals|notEquals|greaterThan|lessThan|contains|changed.

timeout_s.description: Maximum seconds to wait (default 30, clamped to 0-600; must be finite).

poll_interval_ms.description: How often to re-check the condition, in milliseconds (default 100, clamped to 16-5000; must be finite).

view.description: Which view to capture: game (default) or scene.

source.description: Game view only: 'camera' (default) renders a camera and misses Screen Space - Overlay UI; 'screen' captures the composited game view incl. overlay canvases (HUDs), Play Mode only.

save_path.description: Project-relative path to write the PNG (e.g. Screenshots/victory.png).

include_image.description: Also return the PNG inline as base64 (default false: path-only when save_path is set).

capture.description: Capture the game or scene view the moment the condition holds (reuses the capture command internals).

pause.description: Pause play mode on the frame the condition holds (no-op outside play mode).

on_met.description: Follow-up run in the same editor frame the condition first holds: { capture: { view, source, save_path, width, height, include_image }, pause }.

return_history.description: Include the observed value/timestamp samples (a ring buffer of the last 200, so the tail near the transition is kept).

tolerate_missing.description: Treat resolution failures (type/member/instance not found) as condition-not-met and retry until timeout, instead of failing fast. Enables waiting for something to exist (e.g. a spawned object via findType).

async.description: Return a wait_id immediately and evaluate in the background; poll wait_status and cancel with wait_cancel. Use this for long waits and whenever the condition depends on a command you still need to issue — a sync wait blocks it.

tools.name: wait_status
tools.description: Get the status/result of an async wait started with wait_for (async=true).

wait_id.description: The wait id returned by wait_for when async=true.

tools.name: write_text_file
tools.description: Write UTF-8 text to a file under the authoring root, then import it. Overwriting an existing file requires confirm=true.

path.description: Text file path relative to the authoring root, including extension. The Assets/ prefix is optional.

contents.description: The full text content to write (replaces the file).

confirm.description: Required (true) only when overwriting an existing file at the path.

dry_run.description: If true, validate inputs and report what would be written without writing anything.
